messages:
Nina T.: quick PR opened to tidy the observability migration examples + a tiny cost-note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 :wave:
Ravi K.: quick skim 1: Node sample missing the await on fetchTrace(), causes race in the demo app.
Dana M.: I can patch that. also the dashboard filter example uses `traceid` instead of `trace_id` (we standardized on snake_case). will fix both.
Owen H.: UX ask: add a small anchor beside the cost table called "trace attribution" so PMs can link directly to how traces map to costs. tiny html anchor okay.
Nina T.: yes please add anchor and a one-line sentence under the cost table about sequence lengths affecting batching (non-technical).
Dana M.: pushed await + filter name fix, and added the line: "Shorter average sequences improve batching and often lower per-token cost."
Ravi K.: pushed a separate commit to correct fenced codeblock language tags (js -> javascript) so highlighting renders on the site.
docs-bot: docs CI passed for PR #4921 (build 4758) :white_check_mark:
Owen H.: added the anchor `#trace-attribution` and a small example filter: `trace_id = "{{trace_id}}"` for dashboards.
Nina T.: final checklist: 1) squash minor lint bot commit 2) Dana & Ravi approve final diffs 3) merge after noon. Any objections?
Ravi K.: no objections.
Dana M.: fine by me, will re-approve after squash.
Nina T.: thanks all. merging after the squash. tagging #product-docs for visibility :sparkles:
__notes: Short Slack thread coordinating docs PR: small snippet fixes (await, filter name), anchor add, sequence-length cost note, code fence highlight fix, CI pass.
